## 2025-09-24 · Agent git commands fail on index.lock in Abstract worktrees · ABS-11 (chat s-old, turn 1)
Decided: Background reads of an agent's worktree must never write its git index or take its index.lock: the agent runs git there at the same moment, and its commands fail with 'index.lock: File exists'. Read with `git --no-optional-locks`; never add `add -N`, `update-index`, `status` without --no-optional-locks, or anything else that writes the index on a refresh path.
You asked: Agents keep failing with index.lock errors while Abstract refreshes the diff. Fix it.
You corrected: Don't just retry: the refresh itself must stop writing the index.
Agent's summary: Background diff reads now use git --no-optional-locks and never write the agent's index.
